Notes: Machine identity. Get ( UUID ). Never used for cross-file joins.
sync_EVENT::PrimaryKey. The change event this move belongs to; xt_Key and session live on the event.
Tracked field code: name, status, start_date, due_date, assignees, tags, or cf:<ClickUp field ID>. Code layer; never a label.
Label snapshot at write time (custom field name then). Never a matching key.

JSON before the move. Top-level fields: {"v":value}, type fixed by FieldCode. Custom fields: the whole field entry minus type_config. Empty = field absent in that version (nl check: absence is the fact, no other home).
JSON after the move, same shape as OldValue. Empty = field removed. Never both empty.
Human line, e.g. name: Kate → Katherine. Written once by log | event.
Order of the move within its event.
